label: Figure 11.3: Short-run abnormal profits in perfect competition
alt: The industry sets price P; the firm produces at q where MC = MR, and because average cost C is below P at q the shaded rectangle between P and C is abnormal profit.
caption: The firm produces at q, where MC = MR = P. At q the average cost C read from the AC curve is below the price P, so the firm earns an abnormal profit of (P − C) per unit, shown by the shaded rectangle of height (P − C) and width q. The MC curve cuts AC at its minimum.
